== say hi
> Ann: say hi
Ann: You say, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> says, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
== say {target} (literal braces)
> Ann: say {target}
Ann: You say, "<ansi fg="saytext">{target}</ansi>"
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> says, "<ansi fg="saytext">{target}</ansi>"
== shout hi (far text in C)
> Ann: shout hi
Ann: You shout, "<ansi fg="yellow">HI</ansi>"
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> shouts, "<ansi fg="yellow">HI</ansi>"
Cid: Someone shouts from the <ansi fg="exit">west</ansi> direction, "<ansi fg="yellow">HI</ansi>"
== emote waves
> Ann: emote waves
Ann: You Emote: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> <ansi fg="20">waves</ansi>
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> <ansi fg="20">waves</ansi>
== hidden: emote waves
> Ann: emote waves
Ann: You Emote: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> <ansi fg="20">waves</ansi>
Bob: Someone <ansi fg="20">waves</ansi>
== hidden: say hi
> Ann: say hi
Ann: You say, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
Bob: Someone says, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
== whisper Bob psst
> Ann: whisper Bob psst
Ann: You sent a <ansi fg="command">whisper</ansi> to <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi>
Bob: <ansi fg="white">***</ansi> <ansi fg="black-bold"><ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> whispers, "psst"</ansi> <ansi fg="white">***</ansi>
== broadcast hello
> Ann: broadcast hello
Ann: <ansi fg="broadcast-prefix">(broadcast)</ansi> <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi>: <ansi fg="broadcast-body">hello</ansi>
Bob: <ansi fg="broadcast-prefix">(broadcast)</ansi> <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi>: <ansi fg="broadcast-body">hello</ansi>
Cid: <ansi fg="broadcast-prefix">(broadcast)</ansi> <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi>: <ansi fg="broadcast-body">hello</ansi>
== party invite Bob
> Ann: party invite Bob
Ann: You invited <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> to your party.
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> invited you to their party. Type <ansi fg="command">party accept</ansi> or <ansi fg="command">party decline</ansi> to respond.
== party accept (Bob)
> Bob: party accept
Bob: You joined the party!
Ann: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> joined the party!
== party chat hi
> Ann: party chat hi
Bob: <ansi fg="magenta">(party)</ansi> <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> says, "<ansi fg="yellow">hi</ansi>
Ann: <ansi fg="magenta">(party)</ansi> You say, "<ansi fg="yellow">hi</ansi>"
== party leave (Bob)
> Bob: party leave
Bob: You left the party.
Ann: <ansi fg="username">Bob</ansi> left the party.
== say hi (Cid in C, superhearing, hears it from the next room)
> Ann: say hi
Ann: You say, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
Bob: <ansi fg="username">Ann</ansi> says, "<ansi fg="saytext">hi</ansi>"
Cid: (From <ansi fg="exit">west</ansi>) You hear someone talking.
